detector.description: Alerts when a consumer group is lagging behind the latest offset by a 100
detector.name: Kafka - Consumer Group lag > 100 for 1m
detector.programText:
A = data('kafka.consumer_group.lag', extrapolation='last_value').sum(by=['topic', 'partition', 'group']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(100), lasting='1m'), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('Kafka - Consumer Group lag > 100 for 1m')

rules.description: The value of Consumer Group Lag is above 100.
